calib.lyrics:
[verse]
Sun on the pavement, windows rolled down
Every light is green on the way out of town
[chorus]
Take me higher, take me home
Never want to be alone

[verse]
Rain on the tin roof, thunder in my chest
I've been running all night, I can't find rest
[chorus]
Light it up, burn it down
We don't need this town

calib.tags: hip hop,boom bap,male rapper,vinyl crackle,laid back
calib.lyrics:
[verse]
Morning coffee, city noise, pen and a notebook
Every line a brick I lay, every bar a hook
[hook]
Keep it moving, keep it true
[instrumental]

[verse]
Lose yourself in the neon glow
Feel the bass and let it go
[drop]
Hands up, hands up

[verse]
My grandfather's boat sat low in the bay
He taught me the stars and he taught me to pray
[chorus]
Oh the sea remembers
[instrumental]

[verse]
Iron sky, the horizon bleeds
Marching forward on broken knees
[chorus]
Rise, rise, never fall

[verse]
Slow down, slow down, the day is long
Sing it with me, sing a little song
[chorus]
One love on the island breeze

[verse]
Your truck's still in the driveway but your heart is long gone
I kept the porch light burning till the break of dawn
[chorus]
Goodbye was never easy
[instrumental]

[verse]
Come a little closer, let me see your eyes
Every word you whisper feels like a surprise
[chorus]
Stay with me tonight

[verse]
Bailamos bajo la luna, el mundo se detiene
Tu mirada me lo dice, mi corazon te tiene
[chorus]
Dime que si, dime que si

[verse]
夜の街に光が揺れて
君の声が聞こえる気がした
[chorus]
もう一度、あの夏へ

[verse]
Le matin se leve sur la ville endormie
Je marche sans but dans la pluie
[chorus]
Encore une fois, encore une nuit

[verse]
Die Nacht ist jung und wir sind wach
Die Musik laeuft, die Stadt ist nah
[chorus]
Tanz mit mir bis morgen frueh

[verse]
별빛 아래 우리 둘이
손을 잡고 걸어가
[chorus]
끝없이 빛나는 이 밤

[verse]
Woke up this morning with the weight of the world
Got nothing but a guitar and a dusty old girl
[chorus]
Oh the blues don't ever sleep

[verse]
No future, no plans, nothing to lose
Turn it up loud and sing the blues
[chorus]
Hey, hey, we won't go

[verse]
Put your hands together, feel the groove
Everybody's gonna find a move
[chorus]
Get down, get down tonight
[instrumental]

[verse]
I have walked these streets alone
Built a life from stone on stone
[chorus]
But tonight I'll find my voice
[instrumental]

[verse]
A estrada e longa mas eu nao vou parar
Cada passo que eu dou me leva pra lar
[chorus]
Grita comigo, grita mais alto

heldout.lyrics:
[verse]
Paper lanterns drifting up above the water
Every wish we made is a little bit brighter
[chorus]
Hold on to the light

[verse]
Basement walls and a broken amp
Everything I loved is in this lamp
[chorus]
Turn it down and let it ring

[verse]
Sotto il cielo di una sera d'estate
Ti ho cercata per strade bagnate
[chorus]
Resta qui con me

[verse]
Midnight energy, I never switch my lane
Every step I take is a hundred in the rain
[hook]
Count it, count it up

[verse]
春风吹过小河边
花开满山又一年
[chorus]
等你回来看花开
